x-network-numerics.cold_start_fallback: After a failed ordinary nonlinear cold start, retry once with only voltages fixed by ideal paths to ground initialized; startup capacitors participate only at dt=0. No substitute device equations or accepted result. Warm guesses retain their path.

inductor_numerics.endpoints: Integrate every distinct interval; balance short final intervals instead of skipping a fixed duration. Source/output boundaries merge only within the existing four-ULP same-time rule.
inductor_numerics.led: Same clipped forward LED equation, solved in junction voltage with a forward one-sided Jacobian at zero to resolve Is-scale startup; no new reverse leakage.
inductor_numerics.method: Three-stage fifth-order Radau IIA collocation; all stages enforce device KCL and storage equations. Newton requires current residual and voltage-correction convergence; stage iterations share the same output wall deadline.
inductor_numerics.stagnation: Small stagnant corrections with satisfied physical rows reject the trial. Once per accepted state, a larger interval within the same output/source/LC bounds may be proposed; all Newton and full/two-half accuracy checks and original output budgets still apply.
inductor_numerics.startup: Preserve configured/accepted L current and C voltage; require signed current-cut balance and differentiate redundant cutset KCL to determine voltage. DC instead imposes zero L voltage.

x-network-numerics.iteration_budget: 100 iterations per Newton attempt; one additional grounded-constraint cold-start retry; existing per-NPN seed retries remain. Cancellation and integration attempt/time budgets still apply.
x-network-numerics.linear_correction: Full affine MNA correction; even zero excitation checks matrix rank before acceptance
x-network-numerics.nonlinear_correction: Damped Newton; LED, silicon diode, NPN, NMOS, PMOS and unknown future devices retain damping
x-network-numerics.nonlinear_update_scope: The node-update limit applies to legacy networks without L. L networks instead limit forward diode/B-E/B-C junction increments and absolute MOS gate-source increments to 0.2 V; reverse-biased junctions may approach conduction in one proposal. All convergence and node-range checks remain required.
x-network-numerics.rank_check: Every Newton attempt solves its matrix before accepting even a zero-residual initial guess; floating insulated gates are not assigned an arbitrary zero
x-network-numerics.time_integration: Existing network circuits retain backward Euler and other legacy engines remain unchanged. L networks use elab.rlc-mna-radau5.v1 three-stage Radau IIA, conservative full/two-half current/node/charge checks and an LC step ceiling. Existing per-output attempt/time budgets remain; no device-model substitution.

x-source-reference-rules.dc-source: Value is positive minus negative; either terminal may be offset from ground in a referenced network
x-source-reference-rules.network: A common ground reference and independent source/capacitor constraints remain required; accepted node voltages stay within ±30 V and existing solve/work limits
